action_description: walking in place with a slow four-beat walk, one leg lifting at a time, all four legs straight and natural with the hooves stepping cleanly, never bending sideways; facing unchanged, its body turned the same way in every frame
subject_description: a midnight-blue ram with two curled silver-grey horns, just sheared: a slimmer body with a short smooth coat marked with a few opaque pale-yellow stars inside its outline, with no glow or floating sparkles, seen from behind, facing away to the upper right
